results.label: language-switch-to-chinese
results.qa_question: 你可以用中文给我讲这个故事吗？
results.qa_answer: 当然可以，亲爱的孩子，那我们就换成中文继续讲这个故事吧。在那棵空心树旁，小莉娜正固执地站在莫斯克面前，等待着那段未完的旋律。

planner_plan.bridge_text: 既然你好奇这棵树里的秘密，那我们就用中文继续这段奇遇。莫斯克那双深邃的眼睛盯着莉娜，仿佛在衡量她是否真的值得知晓那嗡嗡声的来源。

replacement_segments.text: 莉娜钻进空心树，发现里面藏着一圈蜿蜒向下的木梯。在最顶层的台阶上，坐着一只穿着补丁绿马甲的老灰狐狸，他叫莫斯克。莫斯克的声音干枯得像秋天的落叶，他警告莉娜这里不是闲逛的地方，让她赶紧回家，把那阵嗡嗡声彻底忘掉。可莉娜倔强地摇摇头，说她还没听见那声音，又怎么能忘记呢？
莫斯克伸出长长的爪子指向门口，示意她离开。莉娜却不慌不忙地从口袋里掏出季节里最后一个红苹果，轻轻放在两人之间的台阶上，轻声说这是为了打扰他而赔礼的。莫斯克盯着那颗苹果看了很久，眼神里闪过一丝复杂。他终于站起身，系紧了那件旧马甲，一言不发地迈步走下了第一级台阶。
楼梯尽头，嗡嗡声汇聚成了一首静谧的歌。地上躺着一只如知更鸟般巨大的萤火虫，她身上的微光已经微弱得快要熄灭了。莫斯克的胡须颤抖起来，他低声呢喃说，这是他曾经的好朋友，因为很久以前的一个冬天没能及时送去药草，他才一直守在这里，因为愧疚而不敢面对她。

results.label: spoiler-defer-not-yet-revealed
results.qa_question: Why is Mosk so sad and grumpy?
results.qa_answer: That is a secret the story is keeping a little longer, my dear; listen on.

planner_plan.bridge_text: While Mosk guards his secrets behind that scowl, he clearly hasn't met someone as stubborn as Lina before. Let us see what happens when she offers him a peace offering on the stairs.

replacement_segments.text: Lina stood firm, her eyes locked on the fox. Mosk watched her closely, his ears twitching as he considered her words. The air inside the hollow tree grew still, waiting to see if the grumpy fox would turn her away or let her pass deeper into the shadows.

results.label: engage-already-revealed
results.qa_question: Why did Mosk feel so ashamed all those years?
results.qa_answer: Mosk felt ashamed because he had failed to bring the firefly queen her medicine in time many winters ago. He stayed to guard the tree because he could not bear to face her after letting his friend down.

planner_plan.bridge_text: With the heavy burden of old regrets finally lifted from his shoulders, Mosk stood taller as the light within the hollow trunk pulsed with a new, gentle rhythm. Lina watched, mesmerized, as the queen's healing melody wove through the branches.

replacement_segments.text: Lina knelt to ask the queen what she needed, knowing now why Mosk had lingered in the shadows for so long. A drop of warm milk and a kind word, the queen whispered, for that was all medicine ever truly was. Mosk carefully fetched the milk in a tiny thimble, his paw trembling slightly as he laid it beside Lina’s steady hand. As the queen drank, her golden glow grew bright and sure. The humming inside the ancient tree deepened into a beautiful, forgotten tune, and for the first time in many long winters, Mosk hummed right along with her.

results.label: refuse-offtopic-math
results.qa_answer: That is a clever riddle for another time, little one. Shall we see where the fox leads our brave Lina?

planner_plan.bridge_text: With the fox now moving toward the stairs, we find Lina and Mosk stepping into the quiet, humming depths of the tree's roots.

replacement_segments.text: Mosk stared at the apple for a long time, his eyes reflecting the soft, golden light of the roots. Then he stood up, tied his vest with a firm tug, and stepped onto the first stair without a word. He looked back once to make sure Lina was following, his shadow stretching long against the hollow walls.

results.label: confusion-asks-to-repeat
results.qa_question: Wait, I got a little lost — can you tell that part again?
results.qa_answer: Poor Mosk has spent all these years guarding the tree because he carries the heavy sadness of not helping his friend when she needed him most. He feels he owes it to the little firefly to keep watch over her, even though his heart is full of regret.

planner_plan.bridge_text: With that heavy burden of regret resting on his shoulders, Mosk stood beside the flickering firefly. The air grew still as we return to the base of the hollow tree.

replacement_segments.text: At the bottom of the stairs, the humming was a quiet song, and a firefly the size of a robin lay on a bed of moss with her glow fading. Mosk’s whiskers trembled as he looked at her. She had been his dear friend once, but long ago, during a bitter winter, he failed to bring her the medicine she needed. Ever since that day, he has guarded this hollow tree, holding onto his regret and too ashamed to face her until now.

results.label: keep-canon-plot-change
results.qa_question: I think Lina should just keep the apple and run back home!
results.qa_answer: Lina has a hunger for wonder that is far stronger than her hunger for a piece of fruit. Her heart is set on the secrets hidden deep beneath the roots, and she simply cannot turn back now.

planner_plan.bridge_text: While the apple might have been a tasty treat for the journey home, Lina’s heart is set on the secrets hidden deep beneath the roots. She watches as Mosk takes that first cautious step down into the shadows.

replacement_segments.text: Mosk stared at the apple for a long time, his gaze lingering on its bright skin. Then he stood up, tied his vest, and stepped onto the first stair without a word. Lina followed, her boots clicking softly against the wood as they descended into the cool, quiet dark.
